description: The plot illustrates the WikiText validation perplexity of three large language models (LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B) pruned by various values of M at 70% sparsity using OWL. The x-axis is labeled "M" and features a linear scale ranging from 3 to 8, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "Perplexity" and uses a linear scale with a visible range from 20.0 to 40.0, marked at intervals of 10.0. The LLaMA1-7B model is represented by a solid green line with circular markers; it begins at a perplexity of approximately 28.0 at M=3, declines to a minimum of roughly 24.0 at M=5, and then steadily increases to end at approximately 36.0 at M=8. The LLaMA1-13B model is depicted by a solid orange line with star markers, starting at a value of 20.0 at M=3, decreasing to a minimum of approximately 16.0 at M=6, and subsequently rising back to 20.0 at M=8. Finally, the Vicuna-7B model is shown as a solid blue line with upward-pointing triangular markers, which starts at approximately 41.0 at M=3, drops to a minimum of roughly 34.0 at M=6, and then increases to end at approximately 39.0 at M=8.
caption_used: WikiText validation perplexity of LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B pruned by various M at 70% sparsity using OWL. The perplexity values are plotted against M, ranging from 3 to 8 on the x-axis, with the y-axis representing perplexity values from 20.0 to 40.0. Vicuna-7B (blue line with triangular markers) exhibits a sharp decline from approximately 41.0 at M=3 to a minimum of 30.0 at M=7, followed by a slight increase to 39.0 at M=8. LLaMA1-7B (green line with circular markers) starts at a perplexity of 28.0 at M=3, reaches a minimum of 24.0 at M=5, and increases steadily to 36.0 at M=8. LLaMA1-13B (orange line with star markers) begins at 20.0 at M=3, decreases to a minimum of 14.0 at M=6, and stabilizes at 20.0 by M=8. LLaMA1-13B consistently outperforms the other models across all values of M, with Vicuna-7B showing the highest perplexity throughout the range.
